sloka: पzचिमायाम् अथो द्वारि पुत्रम् इन्द्रजितम् तथा ।व्यादिदेzअ महा मायम् राक्षसैर् बहुभिर् वृतम् ॥६-३६-१८॥।।
transliteration: pazcimāyām atho dvāri putram indrajitam tathā ।vyādideza mahā māyam rākṣasair bahubhir vṛtam ॥6-36-18॥।।

translations.english: Ravana posted Prahastha surrounded by many Rakshasas at the east gate, and the Rakshasas of great prowess, Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the southern gate, and like that Mahamaya and Indrajith, his own son at the western gate.
